text:
yuan: Heads up — during saffron-v2 bring-up I hit a weird repro: q4 quantized build flips bracket ordering and swaps double quotes when the prompt mixes Hebrew (RTL) and Japanese (LTR).

yuan: Minimal repro attached below, happens on both hosted canary and local bench. BLEU on mixed-hj-test drops from 7.2 -> 4.1 after quant. Not just punctuation — trailing kanan/quote tokens get mirrored.

marie: ugh. do you have a short curl or script to reproduce? can we isolate tokenizer vs runtime?

yuan: repro (run against canary saffron-v2-q4):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/canary/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"saffron-v2.q4","input":"日本語のタイトル — וזה ""פרק ראשון"" (end)"}'
```

yuan: expected: 日本語のタイトル — וזה "פרק ראשון" (end)
observed: 日本語のタイトル — םוז "פרק ראשון" (end)  <-- note the Hebrew phrase got internal punctuation reversed (quote moved/turned)

ajay: can you paste tokenizer debug output (tokens + directions)? i want to see where split/merge happens.

yuan: quick token dump from canary run: 
```
tokens: ["日本","語","の","タイトル"," ","—"," ","ו","ז"," ","\"","פ","ר","ק"," ","א","ח","ר","ו","ן","\""," ","(","end",")"]
bidi_flags: [LTR,LTR,LTR,LTR,WS,ON,WS,RTL,RTL,WS,ON,RTL,RTL,RTL,WS,RTL,RTL,RTL,RTL,RTL,ON,WS,ON,EN,ON]
```

yuan: note binder: the double-quote token is classified as ON but quant runtime appears to fold it into adjacent RTL grapheme when applying KV cache indices.

ken: runtime insight — during q4 kernel packing we changed the token->byte alignment for short tokens to shave a bit of memory. if the tokenizer emits separate ZWJ/ZWNJ or standalone punctuation tokens that alignment shift can change the attention index offsets when reconstructing text from kvcache. that could trigger mirror/reorder artifacts for bidi scripts.

marie: so might be an index off-by-one in token->kv mapping specific to quant kernel path. does it reproduce on int8 path?

ajay: tested on int8 canonical: NO repro. int8 and fp16 both fine. appears q4-only.

l10n-bot: added locale sample set "mixed-hebrew-jp-punct" to /datasets/locale-onboard. size: 1200 examples (titles, inline quotes). ran baseline eval: saffron-v2.fp16 BLEU 7.2; saffron-v2.q4 BLEU 4.1; saffron-v2.int8 BLEU 7.1.

ken: good to have dataset. i'll instrument kvcache mapper with extra asserts and run canary. can someone open a bisect?

ajay: starting bisect across q4 kernel commits now. will pin to canary cluster and run the mixed-hebrew-jp-punct set. ETA ~45m.

yuan: also seen a smaller repro where mixing Arabic quoted phrase with Japanese in the same sentence triggers bracket duplication ("(" -> "(("))). might be same root cause.

marie: if kernel packing is the cause, fallback policy could route mixed-bidi requests to int8 until fix. that's reasonable for canary. we should avoid user-facing regressions.

ken: agreed. i'll add a routing rule for canary and dedicated: locale-detect -> if contains strong RTL + CJK then prefer int8/FP16 models for now. i'll push rule as a soft canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment saffron-v2-q4-kernel-fix-test created by ken. ID: deploy-8342.

ajay: bisect progress: narrowed to commit range 3a7f..4b9c which contains the new short-token alignment change. running an A/B with alignment disabled.

yuan: thanks — i'll rerun end-to-end evals after ajay gives green. also adding a synthetic prompt list to capture quote/paren permutations so it's easy to monitor regressions in CI.

marie: nice. add a regression alert that fires if BLEU delta > 1.5 on mixed-hebrew-jp-punct for any quant profile.

l10n-bot: note: add engineers @marta and @rami to the thread for language verification once we have a candidate fix.

yuan: ping me when bisect finishes; saving failing examples to /tmp/saffron-q4-hebrew-jp-fails.json

ajay: bisect finished — culprit confirmed. pushing hotfix patch to q4 kernel (disable short-token pack for ON/BN token classes). running canary tests now.

ken: hotfix pushed. runtime asserts showed several off-by-one mappings in the index builder — fixed.

deploy-bot: Canary health check for deploy-8342: 1/1 endpoints healthy. running locale regression job.

deploy-bot: Locale regression results: mixed-hebrew-jp-punct BLEU: saffron-v2.q4-hotfix 7.0 (baseline fp16 7.2). no punctuation flips observed in sample set.

marie: excellent. create PR and include token dump before/after + unit test. assign to @ken and @ajay.

yuan: thanks team. leaving small monitoring job for this dataset on canary for 72h. will escalate if any drift.

ken: added unit tests and CI guard. PR opened: #4126.

ajay: closing bisect thread, will follow up in changelog and release notes.
